In [[cosmology]], the '''halo mass function''' is a mass distribution of [[dark matter halo]]s.  Specifically, it gives the number density of [[dark matter halo]]s per mass interval.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Wu |first1=Hao-Yi |last2=Zentner |first2=Andrew R.|last3=Wechsler |first3=Risa H. |title=The Impact of Theoretical Uncertainties in the Halo Mass Function and Halo Bias on Precision Cosmology |journal=The Astrophysical Journal |date=2010-04-20 |volume=713 |issue=2 |pages= 856–864 |doi=10.1088/0004-637X/713/2/856|arxiv=0910.3668 |bibcode=2010ApJ...713..856W |doi-access=free }}</ref>
